description: A smaller version of the Daitya without clones straining to burst free from it's orifices.  Instead every opening on its body is filled with teeth.
//grab: All these arms to grab you with

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: A tangle of flesh covered in maws shoots out from %1$s, and its teeth sink into your %2$s!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: A tangle of flesh covered in maws shoots out from %1$s, and its teeth sink into <npcname>'s %2$s!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: A tangle of flesh covered in maws shoots out from %1$s, but glances off your armor.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: A tangle of flesh covered in maws shoots out from %1$s, but glances off <npcname>'s armor.
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: A tangle of flesh covered in maws shoots out from %1$s, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: A tangle of flesh covered in maws shoots out from %1$s, but <npcname> dodges!

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: A meaty tendril slams into your %2$s, sending you flying!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: A meaty tendril slams into <npcname>'s %2$s, sending them flying!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: A meaty tendril slams into your %2$s, but does no damage!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: A meaty tendril slams into <npcname>'s %2$s, but does no damage!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s swings a meaty tendril at you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s swings a meaty tendril at <npcname>, but they dodge!
